newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Simsmetal sees weak trading conditions.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Simsmetal sees weak trading conditions.

text.p: Scrap metals recycler Simsmetal Ltd managing director John Crabb said on Friday that a dramatic weakening in recycled metals prices in the past two months meant that volume, sales and earnings would be below the group's expectations until trading conditions improved.

"Until there is an improvement in the major economies of Europe and Asia and the resulting increase in demand for metals, we expect trading conditions to remain very difficult with volumes, margins and earnings below our expectations," Crabb told the group's annual general meeting.
He said, however, that given declining stocks in some Asian markets, he hoped to see some improvement in demand for ferrous metals early in the new year.
But he said that trading conditions remained very difficult across all of Simsmetal's markets for the moment.
Crabb said recycled metals prices had fallen to a three-year low in the last month and he did not expect them to strengthen from that low in the short-term.

Simsmetal last month reported a 34 percent fall in net profit to A$8.28 million for the three months to September 30, and said it expected second quarter profits to be lower than in the first quarter.
